text:
elaine: Quick sync — prepping launch assets for next Tues. Need to align 1) site hero + mode toggles, 2) launch posts cadence, 3) webinar messaging and registration routing, 4) benchmark snippet for social.

sam: For routing, are we sending demo signups to sales demo queue or trial Onboarding flow?

maria: I think demo -> sales, trial -> self-serve onboarding. Can we have 2 CTAs on page? 'Request a demo' and 'Start free trial' with different UTM?

jake: Design can do dual-CTA hero. Need copy for each button and microcopy under hero explaining who each is for.

elaine: Copy suggestion: hero line 'Consistent inference at production scale'... wait maybe too close to other copy. New take: 'Turn models into predictable production features' — thoughts?

maria: I like that. Emphasize latency & cost in subhead: 'Latency SLOs, cost controls, and flexible deployment — hosted, reserved, or private.' (keeps the three modes but not exact wording)

nora: From Ops: inbound leads should be tagged by CTA. demo leads -> sales_pipeline:sales-demo, trial leads -> onboarding:self-serve. Also add 'webinar' leads -> webinar-nurture list.

deploy-bot: Upcoming webinar registration form added to /integrations/form-builder (deployed) :white_check_mark:

sam: Webinar plan: 45min, 30min demo + 15min Q&A. Need 3 benchmark slides: latency (p50/p95), cost per 1k tokens, and failover behavior when capacity constrained.

maria: I'll draft a 3-bullet benchmark narrative: 1) stable p95 under 200ms for small prompts; 2) autoscale maintains throughput for bursts; 3) fallback to compact variant preserves availability. Keep the language non-technical for top-funnel posts.

jake: For the landing page benchmark slice, can we create a visual microchart (sparkline) and a 1-sentence takeaway? '99% of requests served within our target SLO during benchmark runs.'

elaine: Yes. Action items: Maria — hero + two CTAs copy by EOD Thu. Jake — hero dual-CTA mock + benchmark microchart. Sam — wire inbound routing rules and UTM scheme. Nora — confirm sales routing webhook. I'll assemble launch post schedule (threaded posts + webinar invite) and share later today.

maria: Drafting now. One more ask: make the webinar description avoid 'tech jargon' — focus on 'how teams ship reliably'.

sam: Agreed. Also plan 3 launch posts: announcement, benchmark highlight, webinar reminder. Stagger: announcement (Mon), benchmark highlight (Wed), webinar reminder (Fri).

nora: Will set up form tags and Slack notification to #sales when demo signup comes in.

elaine: Great. If no blockers we'll lock copy by Fri morning. Ping me if anyone needs examples from previous launches. :sparkles:
